notes.title: 1.0.17 - Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
This is another hotfix build for the demo!

This build tries to clarify the last research level in the demo, and introduce more flexibility in the experience.

[b]Fixes / Changes[/b]
- Slow down intro rotation to reduce motion sickness
- Add 'pause to read' option, changing the default to false. See below
- Add clarity to the descriptions of Storage Foundation (Waste), Resource foundation (NANO)
- Add hint from the drone for Waste + Nano if you are still looking for it. These new prompts will get VO soon.

[b]Pause To Read[/b]
Previously, when the hover panel/build/upgrade info was displayed it would pause as to not waste time of day, in an effort for you not to feel rushed as time ticks past. From feedback, this seems like a preference people prefer to not have enabled, so we're trying with the default to off. If you'd like that behaviour, turn it on in the settings menu.

[b]Black flashing blocks[/b]
Please note if you are experiencing this, we are aware of it and are working on fixing it.
You can visit our discord to help fix that. We also have a work around while you wait.

Thanks for all the players that reported issues and tested, we look forward to more feedback!

- Add clarity to the descriptions of Storage Foundation (Waste), Resource foundation (NANO)
- Add hint from the drone for Waste + Nano if you are still looking for it. These new prompts will get VO soon.

notes.title: Visual Upgrade Incoming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/8f63e43d316a894fe8410f42808e28f436d4601c.png[/img]

Good afternoon Future Residents,

A reminder that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kitfox10th]Kitfox 10th Anniversary Sale[/url] is on for two more days. All our games are on sale, so don't miss out! This week's update shows off the visual upgrades we've beamed down to the planet. Even the textual elements are more clear. Read the full brief: 


[h1]Build Detail[/h1]

The building progress visualization module has been installed for Residents which helps clarify status (and just looks cool).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/1974b5596cc30dcf1b157377084cdafafcadda66.gif[/img]
([url=https://anypercent.studio/content/media/2023/05/build.mp4]view high quality[/url])

[h1]Text legibility[/h1]

Previous text display for the mission suffered some artifacts when rendered without high quality settings, and had issues with certain fonts and languages.

We redid all the text visualization to look crisp and clean at any quality or resolution (view the image below full size). We also implemented ways to share all the format and styles across the mission display such that we can change it in one spot and have everything update (e.g for user configurable text scaling and accessibility later).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/b82f32c82436d54ed1f36e5413e3c3782e66166d.png[/img]

Tech details ahead: Text previously was decent (msdf), but is now using the latest [url=https://github.com/Chlumsky/msdfgen]MTSDF[/url] form for best quality and scaling - if you're curious it looks like giant colorful blobs of letters before being shown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/ba74cf65467a7cd0ef7d7efda3009aabec8dd9fc.gif[/img]
([url=https://anypercent.studio/content/media/2023/05/text.mp4]view high quality[/url])

[h1]Lighting display[/h1]

A little more tech related details on "how to fix the muddy colors and make them look better" by fixing the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tone_mapping]tone mapping[/url].

For a small bit of history, when I started this project I implemented it as a blank void where I played with environment lighting. The left hand side was the default exposure for the environment, the right side is the exposure turned all the way up. I thought it looked a lot nicer, and continued to add grass, and then a whole game...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/f4ed2137899eae4b9790bfb42787c8f3dffb92e3.png[/img]

Along the way I must have had trouble with the look and for some reason hardcoded an extra "undo that exposure please" into [i]the global display outcome (not a good idea!)[/i]. This was kinda ruining all the colors, squashing them.

Once I noticed it, I realized all the colors, color grading, and tone mapping were based around this invalid setup. That meant redoing the look from the bottom up, making sure all the colors come through as intended, and just LOOK at the difference ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/39aa10cf2680fcea5fde58727efb71db99226b55.png[/img]

It's not that the game looked bad, but when compared with the new one and what I had intended visually, you can see how flat and muddy it was in comparison.

[h1]Bonus points[/h1]

With all the colors cleaned up, I also added a debanding pass which smooths out all the gradients and colors and makes everything really satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/87cad4e7d87323e43c5f3fb0e34e191ef2087233.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update: Paths, Cameras, Action
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/c5248f24a751e1c5e27680943b77760fe0191287.png[/img]

Hello Residents, It's your mission director checking in with an update about the mission launch.
The preparation for the journey is moving along well, with a lot of loose ends cleared up and a lot of major improvements landing to make our experience better. 

(Note some details/visuals are not final, and the gifs lose a lot of quality!)

[h1]Camera[/h1]
Earlier versions of the camera were a little awkward, relying on keyboard keys and flaky screen edges (especially annoying when viewing from multiple desktops). The camera has been upgraded to drag based, so you can play with just a mouse if inclined (the keys remain). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/ad6515148322c60e7f1c96f8ca16e0fe49c774a6.gif[/img]
([url=https://anypercent.studio/content/media/2023/05/mossfield_origins_camera_drag.mp4]view high quality[/url])

[h1]Paths[/h1]

You'll also probably notice the paths are now cohesively connected. Our previous path representation (if you recall) left a lot lacking, and didn't quite convey what makes them relevant to the mission.

The placeholder paths from before were stones and didn't connect at all (WARNING: old image!):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/c49de0ff2f60ad4afed2e54a77cc540043aa2ed3.png[/img]
The new paths are a lot better, and you get a lot more feedback about how they work and their connectivity and whether they're in use by a resident:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/4a6af3e9bcd1734f3bbe0117b8eb86134fbbff53.gif[/img]
([url=https://anypercent.studio/content/media/2023/05/paths.mp4]view high quality[/url])

[h1]Outlines[/h1]
When inspecting multi-space buildings on the mission, they didn't properly highlight all affected spaces which was unclear to Residents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/4ef3164b269a50da1f3ac1d61711c174c9ad6180.png[/img]

Now they do, and Residents appreciate it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/fa58baa66c023701ffbc75cbc66b8442a073dbfc.png[/img]


[h1]Mission updates[/h1]

We look forward to launching the mission this year Residents, and hope you stay safe and excited. Follow along with the mission launch progress below:

notes.title: Dev update - Launch year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/2b325f68d886604af015330f670215f854cc7ca0.png[/img]


[h1]Launch year[/h1]
That's right Residents, our mission launches this year! The exact date isn't known but when LiFE corporation informs us, we'll let you know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/ad686f3aacd8028463a7e49bd163748262f73ce5.png[/img]

[i]mission parameters initialized... incoming transmission - in world destination located[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/39be55992ab1dd0da481776500f010a664b2ee95.png[/img]

[h2]Play Testing & Events[/h2]
Since mission preparation is ongoing, we've been inviting potential Residents to run through the protocols and it's been going quite well. We've redone the first hour of the mission at least three times, so you know it's working.

If you're a potential Resident interested in testing protocols for the mission, make sure to keep a signal locked with the [url=https://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]Resident Community Space (e.g the Kitfox Games Discord)[/url] if any future opportunities arise.

[h3]Reality Entanglement Breach[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/b67908f423b90c00fb6e500131dbb0eb72cd7b67.png[/img]

We were fortunate to have Mossfield Origins be selected as part of the [b][url=https://gamesinaction.squarespace.com/]Games In Action - Interactivity / Activation \ Activism[/url][/b] event at UBC in Vancouver, Canada. This was the first time the mission was observed in the field with unknown Residents testing experience parameters!

It was valuable to watch Residents who aren't familiar with city-building experiences engage successfully, which is one of our goals. There were also those that did have previous encounters with the genre who reported enjoying it too. Almost all players hit the end of the test (between 45-60 minutes Standard Earth Time) which data confirms was a great success. 

After the event, there were many parameters adjusted to better suit future Residents as a result.

[h2]Mission Development Progress[/h2]
We've solidified the specifications of the expected Resident experience and are now working on the last half of the journey. 

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Part of doing so is making sure we support a range of Residents by localizing the mission experience (please note, localization data shown below was obtained for test purposes and is not final).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/f85ea5a71c641e4780a1a1d5c00bf31ebd618125.gif[/img]

This is more of a debug testing harness, but there's a more directed path for configuring your Resident experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/97631144a3b98dd6d0645b9d01ebdfcef4e6748f.gif[/img]

[h3]Gamepad support[/h3]
Part of our efforts to support a wider range of hardware for Resident experience is making sure gamepad input is fully supported. It progresses well - the capture below shows engaging with gamepad only.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/be594a4355232b2d5ad3fb4bb88b8398a51d0672.gif[/img]

We've also been working on making it easy to choose a different button set. [i]If you look closely and squint past the GIF quality... cough[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/80cf46f9689338aefc6a49db39d49fa6dbe91ccd.gif[/img]

[h1]Resident Enrichment Facilitation[/h1]
More details on other mission parameters from LiFE corporation can be expected in future, but while you wait, enjoy a preview of new homes, new buildings and more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41584394/c49de0ff2f60ad4afed2e54a77cc540043aa2ed3.png[/img]

--- [i]end communication[/i]

[h1]Steam Base Builder Fest[/h1]
Mossfield Origins will also be a part of the Steam Base Builder Fest next week! The event runs January 23 at 10:00 AM PST (UTC-8) to January 30 at 10:00 AM PST (UTC-8) on Steam, so be sure to drop by.
